command: cat <claude-projects-dir> | jq '.items[] | select(.kind=="Deployment" or .kind=="Pod" or .kind=="StatefulSet" or .kind=="DaemonSet" or .kind=="CronJob") | {kind: .kind, name: .metadata.name, configMaps: [.spec.volumes[]? | select(.configMap != null) | .configMap.name, .spec.template.spec.volumes[]? | select(.configMap != null) | .configMap.name, .spec.template.spec.containers[]?.envFrom[]? | select(.configMapRef != null) | .configMapRef.name] | unique}'
kubectl get pods,deployments,daemonsets,statefulsets -n wiki-d923 -o json | grep -o '"name": "[^"]*"' | grep -E "(theme|import-rules|page-templates)" | sort | uniq

kubectl get deployment -n wiki-d923 -o json | jq '.items[].spec.template.spec | {volumes: [.volumes[]? | select(.configMap) | .configMap.name], envFrom: [.containers[]?.envFrom[]? | select(.configMapRef) | .configMapRef.name]}'
kubectl get deployment -n wiki-d923 wikiweb -o yaml | grep -A 5 configMap
kubectl delete configmap import-rules page-templates-2023 -n wiki-d923
